svg.title: Servers and hosts, anywhere: nothing central, one frontend sees them all, in one image
svg.text: Nothing central: one frontend sees them all.
Run a server in the cloud or on site, and put hosts wherever your devices are.
Click in a browser; the host by the device acts
Only the host touches a device. It cannot sit in the cloud: it is wired to them.
Servers anywhere, hosts at any site, one frontend
A host goes where the devices are
A small computer, plugged into your TVs, boxes and phones
Remote, USB and HDMI capture all plug into the host, not the server.
Each host does the heavy work
Next to its own devices, day and night
One more host is more power: each one works for its own devices.
Set it up once, it calls its server
Each host joins one server. One server can have many hosts.
A new site is one more host
Plug a host in there and point it at a server
Nothing changes on the other sites, and the frontend lists the new host.
Pick one server, or All servers to see every host in one list.
